programme_nom: Joint Bachelor in Strategic Communication & Business in Romance Languages

elements_pedagogiques.nom: Language B - Independent User I (A2/B1 -> B1)

acquis_apprentissage.description: Understand the main points of clear standard speech and written texts on familiar academic, social and professional topics.
articipate in routine conversations and discussions, exchanging information and expressing opinions with reasonable fluency.
Produce connected oral and written texts describing experiences, plans, events and viewpoints.
Apply core grammatical structures and vocabulary accurately enough to communicate effectively in familiar contexts.
Recognise similarities and differences between Romance languages and apply intercomprehension strategies to support comprehension.
Demonstrate awareness of cultural conventions and communication norms in Romance-language communities.
Mediate simple information between speakers or texts from different linguistic backgrounds.
Work collaboratively in multilingual learning environments using appropriate communication strategies.
Reflect on their language learning process and identify strategies for autonomous language development.
Understand simple spoken and written messages related to everyday situations.
Use basic vocabulary and grammatical structures to communicate personal information and everyday needs.
Participate in simple interactions involving greetings, requests, descriptions and routine exchanges.
Recognise fundamental phonological and grammatical features of the target language.
Apply basic intercomprehension strategies drawing on knowledge of other Romance languages
Identify basic cultural practices and communication conventions associated with the target language.
Convey simple information from one language to another through basic mediation activities.
Use elementary digital and language-learning resources to support independent study
Produce short oral and written texts on familiar topics.
Understand extended speech, professional presentations and complex written texts on academic and professional topics.
Communicate fluently and spontaneously with native and non-native speakers in a variety of contexts.
Produce clear, detailed and well-structured oral and written texts presenting arguments and supporting evidence.
Use advanced grammatical structures, discourse markers and stylistic conventions with a high degree of accuracy.
Apply specialised vocabulary related to business, strategic communication and professional environments.
Analyse and synthesise information from multiple sources and present it appropriately to different audiences.
Mediate complex information and viewpoints across linguistic and cultural boundaries.
Apply intercultural communication.
Understand the main points of spoken and written texts on familiar academic and social topics.
Participate in conversations on topics related to everyday life, study and work.
Produce connected oral and written texts describing experiences, plans and opinions.
Use a broad range of vocabulary and grammatical structures with increasing accuracy
Recognise cultural norms and communication styles in target-language communities
Employ intercomprehension strategies to interpret texts in related Romance languages
Mediate straightforward information and messages between languages
Demonstrate growing autonomy in language learning and communication.
Work effectively in intercultural learning contexts.

elements_pedagogiques.nom: Language C - Independent User II (B1 -> B2)

acquis_apprentissage.description: Interact with fluency and spontaneity in academic, social and workplace settings.
Use complex grammatical structures, discourse markers and appropriate registers effectively
Employ specialised vocabulary relevant to business, corporate communication and professional contexts
Apply advanced intercomprehension strategies across Romance languages
Demonstrate intercultural competence and adaptability in multilingual environments
Operate independently as a plurilingual communicator in academic and professional contexts
Understand extended spoken and written discourse on concrete, abstract and professional topics.
Produce clear, detailed and coherent oral and written texts adapted to purpose and audience.
Analyse, summarise and evaluate information from diverse sources.
Mediate meaning, information and viewpoints between speakers and texts from different linguistic and cultural backgrounds.

periodes.label: Business / common modules (year not specified by source)

acquis_apprentissage.description: Explain core business concepts (value creation, business models, basic organizational functions).
Describe how key functions (marketing, operations, finance, HR) contribute to firm performance.
Apply basic analytical tools to describe a business situation using simple data and evidence.
Work effectively in teams and communicate a short business analysis in written and oral form.
Use common digital tools to search, structure, and present business information responsibly.
Explain basic microeconomic concepts (scarcity, choice, supply and demand, elasticities).
Describe how markets work and identify common market failures at an introductory level.
Explain basic macroeconomic concepts (GDP, inflation, unemployment, business cycles).
Interpret simple economic indicators and graphs to support basic reasoning.
Discuss economic policy trade-offs using clear, non-technical arguments.
Explain the time value of money and basic discounting concepts.
Read and interpret basic financial statements (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow).
Use simple financial ratios to assess profitability, liquidity, and solvency.
Describe risk/return intuition and the role of diversification at an introductory level.
Build and communicate a basic financial analysis using spreadsheets.
Explain core HRM functions (staffing, development, performance, rewards) at an introductory level.
Describe the basics of motivation, job design, and teamwork in organizations.
Identify key principles of fair and ethical people management (diversity, inclusion, wellbeing).
Apply basic tools for managing performance and feedback in simple scenarios.
Work in teams to propose a basic HR approach aligned with organizational goals.
Explain core marketing concepts (needs, value proposition, segmentation, positioning).
Describe the marketing mix (product, price, place, promotion) at an introductory level.
Apply a simple framework to analyze a market and propose basic marketing actions.
Interpret basic market data (surveys, web metrics, simple experiments) at an introductory level.
Communicate a concise marketing plan outline in teams.
